name: sys-rommsync
//address_space_type: 39-bit, the 64-bit layout since 2.0.0; 1 is the deprecated 36-bit one. sysmodule/README.md, M9-11 (#210).
//filesystem_access: SdCard (bit 21) and nothing else: sdmc: is all this process opens. The README maps each bit to the facility that would need it; npdm.grants fails on any other bit (#210).
//service_access: Every name here is one __appInit waits for and opens; boot.* (tests/test_sysmodule_boot.py) reads this list. A new grant goes in this array, with its WaitForService in main.cpp and its handles in source/handle_budget.hpp -- as pm:dmnt did for #242's foreground-application probe.
//handle_table_size: Derived, not the template's: kHandleTableSize in source/handle_budget.hpp is twice the handles this process holds, rounded up to a power of two, and npdm.grants fails when the two disagree (#210).
//syscalls: Exactly the SVCs the linked image issues, no more: npdm.svcs scans sys-rommsync.elf for svc instructions and fails on any SVC issued and not listed here, or listed and not issued. A call that needs a new one turns that test red; add its line then, not before (#196, #256).
